Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Energex — procurement readiness & security gating (post-demo recap)

Hi Sarah — thanks again for joining the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on procurement: 

Call highlights (short):
- Energex liked the routing + cost controls we showed; primary use-case is inference at scale for real-time analytics (500k tokens/day initial).
- Main procurement questions: PO vs card, whether AWS Marketplace is an option, timeline, and security evidence required (SOC 2, DPA, security questionnaire).

Immediate asks / proposed items:
1) Can you share the procurement contact (name + email) we should align with for PO paperwork?
2) Do you prefer Marketplace billing (AWS Marketplace) or direct PO? Marketplace potentially shortens procurement but has limitations on custom terms.
3) We can share SOC 2 Type II and a DPA template today — is there a secure transfer method you prefer (SFTP/Box link)?
4) If you have a security questionnaire, send it over and we’ll start a pre-fill — note: we commonly need 2–3 business days to fill a standard vendor security questionnaire.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (MAP with milestones), call recording stub (recording_20261109.mp3).

Suggested next step: 30-min procurement + security sync this week to decide PO vs marketplace and confirm timeline. I’m happy to include legal if you want.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.example.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@energex.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Energex — procurement readiness & security gating (post-demo recap)

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear summary and the demo. Quick answers from procurement/security side: 

- Procurement contact: Tom Baxter (Tom.Baxter@energex.com) — I copied procurement; Tom will take the lead on PO process.
- Preferred path: Energex usually does direct PO (corporate card only for very small single invoices). That said, we are evaluating whether we can route via AWS Marketplace for faster subscription billing. Tom will confirm whether Energex has Marketplace entitlements enabled.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II and a signed DPA are required for our InfoSec team to proceed. We also have a 30-question vendor security questionnaire that our team will send; completion is required before final approval.
- Timeline: our typical PO cycle is 3–6 weeks once legal and security sign off. If we elect Marketplace, it can be 1–2 weeks.

Attaching procurement_template.docx (our internal PO/input template) — please populate the billing details. Also please share SOC 2 via secure link (we cannot accept SOC2 over plain email).

If useful, let’s set a 30-min sync tomorrow 11/11 with Tom, myself, Neha, and your solutions/legal lead.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Senior Program Manager, Data Platform | Energex Analytics
sarah.liu@energex.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Energex — procurement readiness & security gating (post-demo recap)

Neha / team — thanks for the heads-up. A couple of pragmatic notes we should surface to Energex to keep the procurement run-rate predictable: 

Commercial paths (short):
- Direct PO (recommended for full contract flexibility): Redwood sales/legal run a Master Services Agreement (MSA) + SOW, PO references invoice number. Typical timeline 3–6 weeks depending on counterparty legal.
- Marketplace (faster, somewhat rigid): AWS Marketplace subscription can be 1–2 weeks if they have an enabled tenant — reduced legal friction but limited ability to negotiate custom indemnities/SLAs. Often good for pilots.

Security & documents we can deliver immediately:
- SOC 2 Type II report (redwood_SOC2_type2_2025.pdf) — can be shared via our secure portal link (we’ll send a time-limited Box link).
- DPA: we have a redwood DPA_draft.docx; we usually share as a redlineable Word doc for their legal team to review.
- Security questionnaire: we can pre-fill the questions but will need legal/engineering to sign off on some answers (2–3 business days typical).

Operational asks for Neha to confirm with Energex: 
1) Does Energex prefer to try Marketplace first for speed or start direct PO?
2) Who is the billing owner (name/email) for legal/PO routing (Tom looks like the right contact).
3) Any special compliance needs (HIPAA, PCI)? — Sarah, flag if there are vertical controls we should be aware of.

Suggested next step: send the SOC 2 secure link and the DPA_draft to Tom/procurement and propose a Thursday 30-min sync (I can join if needed). If they want to pilot, we can offer a 90-day pilot on Marketplace pricing to speed procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com

--
Internal note: include marissa for MRR/discount guidance and to prepare pilot pricing option. Attachments available: redwood_SOC2_type2_2025.pdf (link), DPA_draft.docx (word)
